exposure: spinal anesthesia with bupivacaine plus clonidine
cohort: 60 patients undergoing cesarean sections at Deen Dayal Upadhyay Hospital.
finding: The addition of clonidine to bupivacaine in spinal anesthesia for cesarean sections significantly extended the duration of analgesia, reduced intraoperative hypotension, improved postoperative pain scores, and increased patient satisfaction.
